exposure: reduction in fetal growth between 35 weeks gestation and birth
percentile decrease in estimated fetal weight between 35 weeks and birth (0.01-10.0, 10.01-20.0, 20.01-30.0, 30.01-40.0, 40.01-50.0, and >50.0 percentiles)
Difference between birth weight percentile and estimated percentile weight (EPW) at 35 weeks of gestation
finding: Fetuses with a decrease in estimated fetal weight between the ultrasound at 35 weeks of gestation and birth have a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, the risk being double in fetuses with a decrease of >40 percentile points.
mod_finding: Caesarean or instrumental delivery rates for nonreassuring fetal status were higher in the group of fetuses with a decrease in estimated fetal weight.
